subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler, de forma autônoma, e compreender – selecionando procedimentos e estratégias de leitura adequados a diferentes objetivos e levando em conta características dos gêneros e suportes – romances, contos contemporâneos, minicontos, fábulas contemporâneas, romances juvenis, biografias romanceadas, novelas, crônicas visuais, narrativas de ficção científica, narrativas de suspense, poemas de forma livre e fixa (como haicai), poema concreto, ciberpoema, dentre outros, expressando avaliação sobre o texto lido e estabelecendo preferências por gêneros, temas, autores.

components.description_pt: Selecionar procedimentos e estratégias de leitura apropriados ao gênero e propósito do texto
components.description_en: Select reading procedures and strategies appropriate to the genre and purpose of a literary text

components.description_pt: Demonstrar compreensão de histórias, dramas ou poemas complexos no nível superior da faixa de complexidade 6–8
components.description_en: Demonstrate comprehension of complex stories, dramas, or poems at the high end of the 6–8 text complexity band
components.cc_component_description: Demonstrate comprehension of complex stories, dramas, or poems at the high end of the 6–8 text complexity band

components.description_pt: Distinguir características estruturais e estilísticas de diferentes gêneros e mídias literárias
components.description_en: Distinguish among structural and stylistic characteristics of different literary genres and media
components.cc_component_description: Compare structural and content differences between fiction and nonfiction text types

components.description_pt: Expressar respostas avaliativas a textos literários lidos independentemente
components.description_en: Express evaluative responses to literary texts read independently
components.cc_component_description: Write responses to literature that draw on textual evidence to support comparisons

components.description_pt: Articular preferências pessoais por gêneros, temas e autores literários com base em experiência de leitura
components.description_en: Articulate personal preferences for literary genres, themes, and authors based on reading experience

cc_matches.description: By the end of the year, read and comprehend literature, including stories, dramas, and poems, at the high end of grades 6—8 text complexity band independently and proficiently.
Explain major differences between books that tell stories and books that give information, drawing on a wide reading of a range of text types.

Apply grade 5 Reading standards to literature (e.g., "Compare and contrast two or more characters, settings, or events in a story or a drama, drawing on specific details in the text [e.g., how characters interact]").
